description: This file is a shell script that automates testing of Git repository cloning functionalities, specifically focusing on cloning with detached HEAD states. It sets up a repository, performs various clone operations, and verifies whether the HEAD is detached or not after each operation.

methods.name: head_is_detached
methods.description: Checks if the cloned repository's HEAD is detached by verifying HEAD with 'git rev-parse' and attempting to get the symbolic-ref of HEAD, expecting failure if detached.
